title: When the Colony Wakes Anew
author: Mirabel Villalobos
blurb: Casper Okafor, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
